responses:
The topology encodes a separate transfer path for every destination/partition. Unless the evaluator explicitly deduplicates identical edges across those path lists, a shared Steiner tree does not reduce billed transfer: each destination still traverses and pays for its full route. Per-destination shortest paths are therefore the cost lower bound, while also removing substantial exponential DP runtime.
